verdicts.title: Algebraic Proofs over Noncommutative Formulas
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We study possible formulations of algebraic propositional proof systems operating with noncommutative formulas. verdicts.title: A weight-formula for all highest weight modules, and a higher order parabolic category $\mathcal{O}$
verdicts.abstract_excerpt:
Let $\mathfrak{g}$ be a complex Kac-Moody algebra, with Cartan subalgebra $\mathfrak{h}$. Also fix a weight $λ\in\mathfrak{h}^*$. For $M(λ)\twoheadrightarrow V$ an arbitrary highest weight $\mathfrak{g}$-module, we provide a cancellation-free, non-recursive formula for the weights of $V$.
